title: The Animal That Prays
listing_description: Using an explicitly methodological AI persona, this intellectual experiment examines religion as experience, biology, social technology, moral amplifier, and infrastructure of power. It separates evidence, inference, controlled speculation, and limits while testing claims about cooperation, hierarchy, altered states, secular sacreds, artificial minds, and transcendence without pretending to settle metaphysics.
reader_hook: What can an intelligence without childhood, mortality, ritual belonging, or revelation see—and miss—about the animal that prays? Across neuroscience, anthropology, history, psychedelics, cooperation, empire, genetics, secular ideologies, and AI, the book keeps religious experience, institutional power, and metaphysical uncertainty in view without reducing one to another.
